task: Five-digit mean absolute change across the three nominal 40-ms steps from t+40 to t+160 ms on the archive row grid.

origin.name: Kai Joshua Miller, A library of human electrocorticographic data and analyses

preparation.transformation: Use the first 362000 source rows [0,362000), keeping original data and flex matrices, raveled electrode-region code and cue[:,0]. Write ecog, flex, region_code and cue in that order using NumPy savez_compressed. The source member must be obtained separately.

source_calibration: 0.0298 µV per amplifier count; 46 original channels. No glove-to-angle calibration.

preparation_software_checked.scope: Exact hash from re-packing the verified development arrays. Raw MAT preparation was not rerun for this experiment.

analysis.earlier_individuals_or_pretraining: No pretrained weights or external people used. Single recording preallocated to development.
analysis.independent_reference: Future recorded five-sensor glove changes; no physical joint-angle or fingertip-position calibration.

example.invented_generator: numpy.random.default_rng(1729), artificial sinusoids, noise and independent invented glove comparator
